pos.personaBrief: Brazil under Tite dominated possession (Coutinho dictating tempo, 70% vs Costa Rica, 'tend to dominate possession'), with a deep block met by patient circulation, though it also sought quick ball recovery.

pro.personaBrief: Fast-paced circulation through triangular combinations, a safe holder (Casemiro) and full-backs stepping inside show patient build-up, with quick transitions only as a complement.

est.personaBrief: 4-1-4-1 with defined roles (holder, playmaker, box-to-box), rigid structure and triangles, with inverted full-backs and a roaming forward line adding relational movement.

lar.personaBrief: Wingers stay wide against compact blocks (Willian, Neymar) but the core is central triangles and full-backs tucking into midfield; play is not built on one-on-one crosses.

blo.personaBrief: Moved the defensive line 20m higher, compact lines, high/mid/low press tailored to the opponent and 'attacking while defending' for immediate counter-pressing.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal marking is the basis of everything per Cleber Xavier (open play and set pieces), with no dedicated man-marker for stars.

pla.personaBrief: A fixed methodology but visible adaptation: rigid back four in Germany 2018, no double pivot against deep blocks, tailored high press, video prep for players.

res.personaBrief: A pragmatic winner who balances attack with solidity; result-oriented and disciplined but not abandoning his possession style.

sis.personaBrief: 'The collective empowers the individual': stars like Neymar get structure built around them but with defined roles and duties, with the system valued above individuals.

jog.personaBrief: Valued technical, intelligent midfielders (Renato Augusto, Coutinho) alongside disciplined athletic ones (Casemiro, Paulinho); intensity required but no classic 10 who does not run.

bas.personaBrief: Relied on experienced veterans (Thiago Silva, Dani Alves, Marcelo, Paulinho) while gradually bringing in youngsters like Vinicius and Rodrygo.

lid.personaBrief: Group harmony and collective spirit (LeBron blueprint, rotating captaincy, good relationship with players) alongside clear rules applied to stars.
